meta.name: Julie and the Phantoms
meta.description: Julie es una adolescente que encuentra su pasión por la música y por la vida con la ayuda de una banda de chicos adolescentes, llamados The Phantoms, que han estado muertos durante 25 años. Para devolverles el favor, la muchacha decide ayudar al grupo a convertirse en aquello que siempre quisieron pero nunca pudieron ser.

videos.title: Wake Up
videos.overview: A year after her mom passed away, Julie plays one of her old CDs. Suddenly, three ghosts appear — the guys from the '90s band Sunset Curve!

videos.title: Bright
videos.overview: When Julie starts singing again, the boys and her best friend Flynn encourage her to fight for a spot in the school music program.

videos.title: Flying Solo
videos.overview: Julie's performance makes a big splash, and the guys try to convince her to join Sunset Curve — but she'll have to come clean to Flynn first.

videos.title: I Got the Music
videos.overview: Flynn books Julie and the Phantoms to play at the school dance, Alex hangs out with his new crush, and the boys decide to teach an old friend a lesson.

videos.title: The Other Side of Hollywood
videos.overview: Willie brings the guys to an exclusive club, where a powerful ghost magician asks them to be in his band. But he's got something up his sleeve.

videos.title: Finally Free
videos.overview: Julie pairs up with Nick for a school performance and learns he broke up with Carrie. The band gets a new gig, but Julie's grounded for missing class.

videos.title: Edge of Great
videos.overview: Julie rehearses with Nick — while daydreaming about Luke. Alex wonders why Willie's been acting so weird. The band plays a party at Julie's house.

videos.title: Unsaid Emily
videos.overview: Julie meets Luke's parents and shares a touching song he wrote. Luke confides in Julie about Caleb and the band's "unfinished business."

videos.title: Stand Tall
videos.overview: Julie and the Phantoms get their dream gig at the Orpheum! But when Caleb interferes, Julie searches for the courage to perform on her own.

videos.title: Behind the Band Ep 1: Casting
videos.overview: Go behind the scenes of the final auditions for Julie and the Phantoms with Madison, Charlie, Owen and Jeremy as they vie for the roles of Julie, Luke, Alex and Reggie.
